# cjs-module-lexer 2.1.0

`lexer.wasm.base64` is the base64 encoding of `lib/lexer.wasm` from the
official `nodejs/cjs-module-lexer` tag `2.1.0` (commit tag object
`e0cf70d98974ca2c24e226adecfb5e4ba36bc66c`). It is decoded in memory by the
Rust adapter; keeping the repository representation textual allows ordinary
patch review while preserving the exact upstream bytes.

Decoded SHA-256: `590706aacfdc4a47fc8667dd98c83e47a289630574062b089ac4b19d1be8e13a`.

Upstream: <https://github.com/nodejs/cjs-module-lexer/tree/2.1.0>
